subject: Post-signature flight plan: MAP + evaluation & canary schedule
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ng <alex.ng@pioneercloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature flight plan: MAP + evaluation & canary schedule

Alex —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is the first draft of the mutual action plan (MAP) and an embedded post-signature flight plan. High level:

- Goal: Production rollout of Redwood inference for PioneerCloud main tenant (region: us-west) by Aug 15, 2025.
- Key phases: prep & baseline eval (week 1–3), canary (week 4), migration cutover (week 6), training & handoff (week 6–8).
- Acceptance gates: latency percentile targets, functional eval pass rate (see evaluation sheet), and security checklist sign-off.

Asks from your side:
1) Confirm PO / billing contact so procurement can be looped in.
2) Nominate an internal technical POC for sandbox access and verification.
3) Confirm preferred blackout windows for migration (we suggested Aug 10–16 as a tentative target).

Attached: MAP_PioneerCloud_v1.xlsx (master timeline + owners), eval_prompt_samples.txt (sample prompts we'll use for regression monitoring).

I'll loop in our CSM and implementation lead for detailed scheduling. Once we have your POC and procurement ETA we can lock dates in the MAP and spin up the sandbox.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP_PioneerCloud_v1.xlsx)
From: Alex Ng <alex.ng@pioneercloud.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Onboarding Team <onboard@pioneercloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@pioneercloud.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature flight plan: MAP + evaluation & canary schedule

Sergio —

Thanks for this and congrats — we’re excited to get started. Quick notes from procurement & internal ops:

- PO: procurement expects to issue the PO by Jun 24 if the final SOW doc is unchanged. I copied them.
- POC: I’ll assign Ravi Patel as the technical POC (ravi.patel@pioneercloud.com). He’ll want early sandbox access to validate our traffic patterns.
- Canary gates: can you add an explicit list of metrics (p95 latency target, mean token cost, and sample-response fidelity checks) that we can sign off on?

We prefer a shorter training window (labor constraints) and would like pre-recorded sessions + on-demand sandbox lab instead of a week-long live training. Is that feasible?

Alex
Alex Ng
Head of Cloud Ops, PioneerCloud
alex.ng@pioneercloud.com
(Attachment: internal_approval_timeline.pdf)

Alex / team —

I’m Marissa (CSM) — I’ll own adoption and success for PioneerCloud. Next steps from our side:

1) Evaluation plan: see attached eval_prompt_samples.txt for the prompt sets we’ll run against your baseline. We propose three evaluation waves: baseline (pre-canary), canary (subset traffic), and post-cutover (regression sweep).
2) Training: we can compress the live training to two half-day sessions + 6 on-demand labs and two 60-min office hours. We’ll provide pre-recorded walkthroughs and a sandbox workbook so your engineers can self-pace.
3) Sandbox access: we’ll provision a sandbox environment with realistic token throttles and sample data. Need Ravi’s email to set IAM.

Ben — can you prepare an abbreviated canary gating doc with the specific metrics Alex requested? Laura — once you and I agree on the canary cadence I’ll update the MAP owners column.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: eval_prompt_samples.txt)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ng <alex.ng@pioneercloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Canary runbook & phased rollout proposal

Alex / Ravi / team —

Attaching the canary_runbook.pdf (stub) with a proposed 4-week canary cadence. Highlights:

Week 1 — Smoke & baseline: run our eval prompts against your sandbox, confirm baseline p95 < 350ms for target model, and validate sample responses for correctness (we'll use the fidelity checklist in the runbook).
Week 2 — Controlled traffic ramp: 5% -> 20% of non-critical traffic; measure cost/token and error rate.
Week 3 — Full feature tests: feature flags on, retrain/update caches as per model variant; run integration tests.
Week 4 — Pre-cutover regression sweep: final acceptance checks, rollback plan rehearsed.

Migration notes:
- Data migration: no customer PII in payloads; if you need KV-state transfer we’ll support an exported snapshot and a short reindex window.
- Rollback: automatic routing fallback to previous model and circuit-breakers at the routing layer.

Owners & contacts:
- Redwood implementation: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai)
- CSM: Marissa Cole
- SE support: Ben Carter

Next action: Laura to schedule a 30-min canary gating walkthrough with Ravi this week.

Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: canary_runbook.pdf)
From: Alex Ng <alex.ng@pioneercloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Canary runbook & phased rollout proposal

Laura / team —

Thanks — this is the level of detail we needed. A few requests from our ops team (Ravi copied):

- Please add explicit numeric gate thresholds in the runbook (example: p95 < 400ms, error rate < 0.2%, fidelity pass > 92%).
- We need sandbox access 10 business days before canary start so our team can validate traffic shaping. Can you confirm provisioning timeline?
- Training: we'll take the compressed training plan but want the two live sessions to be scheduled in the week before cutover (not during). Also request session recordings and the sandbox workbook.

Ravi — I’ll coordinate availability for the walkthrough.

Alex
